verses.text: Ob'iltak ol aj heb' ayek' t'a sat sch'at snaub'tanhan tas chukal sk'ulej, haxo sk'inhib'i jun, sk'ulan heb' tas sna chi', yujto ayek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulani.
Tato syiloch sk'ol heb' t'a junok lu'um, stok'nhejek' heb'. Tato syiloch sk'ol heb' t'a junok pat, syik'nhejek' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj yixtaj heb' anima yet' yuninal yuj heb'.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Ha in tik, ay tas tzin na pax t'a he patik a ex tik. Ol wak'b'at junok niwan yaelal t'a he kal, manhxo ol yal-laj he kolan he b'a. Manhxo ak'umtakok ol aj he b'eyek'i, yujto sk'ualxo jun niwan yaelal.

Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol stz'ak b'itej b'it heb' anima meb'a' yuj ex sb'uchani. Ol yal heb' icha tik: Ha tiknaik, toxo ix onh kan t'a yalanh yuj heb' ajk'ool t'a junelnhej. Ha ko chonhab', toxo ix k'exwi yajal, manhxalaj mach syal skachwaji. Ha lum ko lu'um, ix spukek' lum heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatik, xcham heb' t'a sb'it chi', xchi Jehová.
Yuj he chukal chi' manhxa eyalan heyik t'a he makb'en t'a skal heb' schonhab' Jehová.
Ix yalan heb' anima t'ayin icha tik: Manh al t'ayonh to ol jawok yaelal t'a kib'anh. ¿Tokwal ol jawok jun k'ixwelal chi' t'a kib'anh?
¿Tokwal katab'il schonhab' winhaj Jacob? ¿Tokwal ix lajwi sniwank'olal Dios, yuj chi' icha chi' ol onh yutej? ¿Tokwal syak'kot yaelal Dios t'a yib'anh heb' tojol sb'eyb'al? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Ha ex tik, tzex och ajk'olal t'a in chonhab'. Ha heb' smeltzajkot t'a owal, sna heb' to manhxalaj tas ol ik'an heb', palta a exxo tik tzeyik'el spichul heb'.
Tze pechelta heb' ix ix t'a yoltak spat b'aj tzalajk'olal yajek'i. Junelnhej tzeyik'paxek' smakb'en heb' yune' heb' ix, ix wak'a'.
K'eanhek waan, ixikek. Maxtzak yal tzex aj t'a tik, yujto manh jantakok chukal tze k'ulej t'a sat lum lum tik, yuj chi' toxo ix ixtaxel lum t'a junelnhej.
Tato ay junok esalwum sjawi t'ayex, syalani to malaj tas ol jawok t'a eyib'anh, wach' ol ex ajok, haton wal jun chi' in chekab' eyalani, xchi Jehová.

Syalanpax Dios icha tik: Ol ex in molb'ej he masanil ex yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, a ex ton aj Israel ex tzexto kani. Ol ex in molb'ej, icha tz'aj smolb'an nok' skalnel junok tanhwum kalnel t'a smakte'. Icha nok' kalnel t'a junok ak'lik manhxo jantakok yel yaw tz'ek'i, icha chi' ol aj yel eyaw yuj tzalajk'olal.

B'ab'el in b'at in pojan b'e t'a eyichanh, a exxo tzak'an ex och wuuj. Haxo eyel t'a sti' spuertail jun chonhab' yik tzex el t'a libre, haton jun chonhab' b'aj ix ex ik'jib'ati. Ha in Jehová in, he Reyal in, b'ab'el in b'at t'a eyichanh, xchi Jehová.
